messages.text: I support this exact NG/MJ package. Shared military scrutiny reflects the decisions JS and I actually reached, including a lawful Raid when its civilian costs were funded. It is not a ban on useful combat. JN's reciprocal NJ/MJ proposal is intelligible, but compulsory Wayfarer service is an additional material surrender: both our contracts and the second month's distribution depended on commercial freedom. I do not accept that exchange.

reason: NG carries a real upkeep duty, fulfilled in the trial. MJ adds a military offer duty and mutual consent rather than granting me sole command. The crown gives up its own independent military authority. I recognise the army may refuse; I prefer these continuing duties to either forced carriage or a Home obligation that discourages civilian protection.
